with
  params as (
    select
      1::bigint as team_id
  ),
  player_roster as (
    select distinct
      r.player_id,
      r.season_id
    from
      public.roster r
      cross join params prm
    where
      r.team_id = prm.team_id
  ),
  skater_appearances as (
    select
      gr.player_id,
      gr.game_id,
      g.season_id
    from
      public.game_roster gr
      join public.game g on g.game_id = gr.game_id
      cross join params prm
    where
      gr.team_id = prm.team_id
      and gr.position = 'S'
  ),
  team_scoring_events as (
    select
      se.*
    from
      public.scoring_event se
      cross join params prm
    where
      se.team_id = prm.team_id
  ),
  goals as (
    select
      se.goal_scorer_id as player_id,
      g.season_id,
      COUNT(*) as goals
    from
      team_scoring_events se
      join public.game g on g.game_id = se.game_id
      join skater_appearances sa on sa.game_id = se.game_id
      and sa.player_id = se.goal_scorer_id
      and sa.season_id = g.season_id
    where
      se.goal_scorer_id is not null
    group by
      se.goal_scorer_id,
      g.season_id
  ),
  assists as (
    select
      aid.player_id,
      g.season_id,
      COUNT(*) as assists
    from
      (
        select
          se.assist_1_id as player_id,
          se.game_id
        from
          team_scoring_events se
        where
          se.assist_1_id is not null
        union all
        select
          se.assist_2_id as player_id,
          se.game_id
        from
          team_scoring_events se
        where
          se.assist_2_id is not null
      ) aid
      join public.game g on g.game_id = aid.game_id
      join skater_appearances sa on sa.game_id = aid.game_id
      and sa.player_id = aid.player_id
      and sa.season_id = g.season_id
    group by
      aid.player_id,
      g.season_id
  ),
  penalties as (
    select
      pe.player_id,
      g.season_id,
      COALESCE(
        ROUND(
          EXTRACT(
            EPOCH
            from
              SUM(pe.duration)
          ) / 60
        )::int,
        0
      ) as penalty_minutes
    from
      public.penalty_event pe
      join public.game g on g.game_id = pe.game_id
      join skater_appearances sa on sa.game_id = pe.game_id
      and sa.player_id = pe.player_id
      and sa.season_id = g.season_id
      cross join params prm
    where
      pe.team_id = prm.team_id
    group by
      pe.player_id,
      g.season_id
  ),
  appearance_games as (
    select
      sa.player_id,
      sa.season_id,
      COUNT(distinct sa.game_id) as games_played
    from
      skater_appearances sa
    group by
      sa.player_id,
      sa.season_id
  )
select
  s.season_name,
  pl.first_name || ' ' || pl.last_name as player_name,
  COALESCE(ag.games_played, 0) as gp,
  COALESCE(g.goals, 0) as g,
  COALESCE(a.assists, 0) as a,
  COALESCE(g.goals, 0) + COALESCE(a.assists, 0) as pts,
  case
    when COALESCE(ag.games_played, 0) = 0 then null
    else ROUND(
      (COALESCE(g.goals, 0) + COALESCE(a.assists, 0))::numeric / ag.games_played,
      2
    )
  end as pts_per_gp,
  COALESCE(pe.penalty_minutes, 0) as pim
from
  player_roster p
  join public.players pl on pl.player_id = p.player_id
  join public.season s on s.season_id = p.season_id
  left join goals g on g.player_id = p.player_id
  and g.season_id = p.season_id
  left join assists a on a.player_id = p.player_id
  and a.season_id = p.season_id
  left join penalties pe on pe.player_id = p.player_id
  and pe.season_id = p.season_id
  left join appearance_games ag on ag.player_id = p.player_id
  and ag.season_id = p.season_id
order by
  case s.season_name
    when 'Fall Winter 24/25' then 1
    when 'Summer 25' then 2
    when 'Fall Winter 25/26' then 3
    when 'Summer 26' then 4
    when 'Fall Winter 26/27' then 5
    else 6
  end;
